fee_notes: Royalty is not a % of gross sales but a per-Subject-Student fee: $15 per newly enrolled student per month; ongoing monthly royalty ranges $33–$42 per Subject-Student based on total Subject-Students enrolled in one Authorized Curricula subject. Minimum monthly royalty of $1,500 applies after one year from first Subject-Student enrollment. Summit of Math Continuing Service and Royalty Fee: $10–$15 per Subject-Student per month. Brand Development Fund: $1.00 per Subject-Student per month (not applied to Summit of Math students). Cooperative Advertising contribution amount determined by cooperative vote. Growth Incentive: $1,000 royalty credit if 30 subject students enrolled within 90 days of first enrollment; additional $1,000 credit if 80 subject students enrolled within 180 days.
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Service and Royalty Enrollment Royalty Fee: For each reporting month, $15 times the number of newly enrolled students. Monthly royalty will range from $33 -$42 per Subject-Student and will be based on the total number of Subject- Students enrolled in one Authorized Curricula subject. A Minimum monthly royalty of $1,500 applies after one year from the date you enroll the first Subject-Student.

Summit of Math Continuing Service and Royalty Fee: Monthly royalty will range from $10 -$15 per Subject-Student and will be based on the total number of Subject- Students enrolled in one Authorized Curricula subject.

Brand Development Fund ("Fund"): $1.00 per Subject-Student. By the 20th day of the month based on Subject-Students enrolled in the previous month.

Cooperative Advertising Programs ("Cooperative"): We may establish a local marketing cooperative for Eye Level Learning Centers in your area. The owners of the Cooperative will determine by vote how much you will be required to contribute to the Cooperative and when your contribution will be due.
